notes: Articles 19a(9) and 29a(8) of Directive 2013/34/EU exempt an undertaking only where 'such undertaking and its subsidiary undertakings' are included in the parent's consolidated management report or qualifying consolidated sustainability reporting. notes: Article 29a(8), second subparagraph, point (a)(i)–(iii), of Directive 2013/34/EU (Article 19a(9) carries the same list): the exempted undertaking's management report states the name and registered office of the parent that reports at group level, the weblinks to that parent's consolidated (sustainability) report and to the assurance opinion, and that the undertaking is exempted.
